pick.name: Better-T-Stack (create-better-t-stack)
pick.what: CLI scaffolding a typed TS monorepo: Next/TanStack Start + Expo (uniwind) + Hono + Drizzle + Better Auth + oRPC/tRPC + Turborepo + Tauri/Electrobun addons
pick.why: Generates almost exactly the recommended one-stack (incl. Expo and Turborepo) in one command; has an MCP server and bts.jsonc for re-runs
pick.install: pnpm create better-t-stack@latest --frontend next native-uniwind --backend hono --orm drizzle --auth better-auth --api orpc --addons turborepo

alts.name: Open SaaS (Wasp)
alts.what: Full SaaS template: auth, payments, admin, docs
alts.why: Most features out of the box for a web-only SaaS

alts.name: next-forge (Vercel)
alts.why: Polished web+API monorepo if no mobile

candidates.name: Better-T-Stack (pick)
candidates.verdict: Matches web+mobile+desktop+API; options cover Hono, Drizzle, Better Auth, Turborepo, Tauri/Electrobun.

candidates.name: Open SaaS / Wasp
candidates.verdict: Wins for a web-only SaaS with payments/admin prebuilt; Wasp DSL is extra lock-in and no Expo app.

candidates.name: next-forge
candidates.verdict: Good Next-only monorepo; no mobile; last release May 2026.

candidates.name: create-t3-turbo
candidates.verdict: npm package dormant since 2023 (repo may be newer) - superseded.

candidates.name: Paid kits (Makerkit, Supastarter)
candidates.verdict: Billing/admin prebuilt but paid; not needed for free-first.

decision: Better-T-Stack scaffolds the cross-platform monorepo in one command; add Electron by hand (it offers Tauri/Electrobun addons, not Electron). Use Open SaaS instead for a quick web-only SaaS where payments/admin matter more than mobile.
details: Better-T-Stack weekly downloads are low (~2.3k/wk) because it is a one-shot CLI; the templates are what matter.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
